Enterprise RAG Architecture

An enterprise knowledge agent platform combines document retrieval, SQL analytics,
tool calling, and multi-agent orchestration. A typical workflow includes document ingestion,
chunking, local embeddings, vector search, source-grounded answer generation, confidence scoring,
and benchmark evaluation.

Local deployment with Ollama and FAISS can support privacy-sensitive prototypes without paid cloud APIs.

Healthcare AI Governance Notes

Clinical AI systems should support decision-making but should not replace clinician judgment.
A reliable enterprise AI platform should include data lineage, source citations, audit logs,
privacy controls, hallucination checks, and confidence scoring.

Important healthcare AI evaluation topics include model performance, fairness, calibration,
explainability, uncertainty, and human review.

Public Sector Analytics Notes

Public-sector analytics projects often require de-identification, secure data access, role-based
permissions, reproducibility, and careful communication with non-technical stakeholders.

For education and government data, the platform should avoid exposing raw PII and should
separate public portfolio sample data from secure internal data sources.

Image note: enterprise AI platform architecture diagram.

The diagram shows a user question routed through an agent router into document RAG, SQL analytics,
and image-note tools. Retrieved evidence is aggregated and passed to a local Ollama model.
The final answer includes citations, confidence score, and hallucination risk check.
